objective: Select exactly one leakage-safe rich-description interface for the Level 2 thesis mainline while keeping all alternative design exploration in the appendix.
research_question: Which bounded interface for the same frozen label-side semantic fields best transfers to a pseudo-unseen aspect without increasing false-positive collapse?

thesis_role.main_text: One frozen R condition only, compared with N and D in Level 2.
thesis_role.appendix: All candidate interfaces, development folds, negative results, diagnostics and selection evidence.

data_contract.pseudo_unseen_contract: Rotate each of the twelve aspects as pseudo-unseen. Remove every fit row containing that aspect, train or fit only with the other eleven aspects, select the operating threshold on seen-aspect development rows, and use pseudo-unseen labels for evaluation only.

D.label: minimal definition
D.positive_prototypes: canonical name plus exact minimal definition

R1_concat.label: existing naive rich concatenation
R1_concat.positive_prototypes: name, definition, aliases, inclusion and contrastive boundary concatenated

R2_positive_concat.label: positive-only rich concatenation
R2_positive_concat.positive_prototypes: name, definition, aliases and inclusion concatenated

R3_prototype_max.label: separate positive prototypes with maximum aggregation
R3_prototype_max.positive_prototypes: name-plus-definition, each alias, and inclusion boundary scored separately

R4_prototype_top2.label: separate positive prototypes with top-two mean aggregation
R4_prototype_top2.positive_prototypes: name-plus-definition, each alias, and inclusion boundary scored separately
R4_prototype_top2.aggregation: mean of the two highest similarities

R5_contrastive_top2.label: top-two positive aggregation with a separate exclusion penalty

tfidf_field_similarity.field_similarity: mean of word and character cosine
tfidf_field_similarity.fit_corpus: fit-partition review text plus seen-aspect field text only

selection.threshold_population: seen-aspect rows in the development evaluation partition only
selection.threshold_objective: aspect-presence micro-F1, with higher threshold then lexical ordering as deterministic ties
selection.rich_candidate_ranking: largest unweighted mean AP delta versus D over method by pseudo-unseen-aspect by row-partition records
selection.stability_reporting: report per-method deltas and the count of twelve aspects with positive mean delta
selection.near_tie_rule: If candidates differ by no more than 0.005 mean AP, select the simpler interface using R2_positive_concat, R4_prototype_top2, R3_prototype_max, R5_contrastive_top2, R1_concat as the simplicity order.
selection.single_resource_rule: Select one rich interface globally; no per-model or per-aspect rich selection.
selection.formal_confirmation_gate: Freeze the winning interface, lambda if applicable, code contract and hashes before any official-validation confirmation.

stage_contract.formal_selected_rich: The selected structured rich interface changes Stage 1 only; Stage 2 keeps the frozen canonical name plus minimal definition so the rich comparison isolates aspect detection.

execution_order: one-aspect one-partition smoke for both methods
one validation-only TF-IDF and E5 confirmation
regenerate formal cloud plan and live-host gates

smoke_amendments.observation: The original absolute exclusion subtraction shifted the E5 score scale below the shared D threshold and produced a zero-prediction smoke result.
smoke_amendments.change: Use a scale-preserving contrastive penalty only when exclusion similarity exceeds the positive top-two score.

stop_conditions: any validation or official-test access during development
any target-label use in descriptor authorship
held-out descriptor text entering a TF-IDF fit corpus

commit_policy.tracked: configuration, code, tests, aggregate summaries, non-sensitive appendix tables and documentation
commit_policy.local_only: review text, row-level predictions, model caches, checkpoints and large artifacts
